intendedUse: Small frontal campaign-map city icons; 32-48px target display.
commonPrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one SMALL ABSTRACT FRONT-ELEVATION CITY MAP ICON, for 32 to 48 PIXEL display in a Three Kingdoms game.
This is NOT a miniature town illustration. It is a bold, compact, almost pictographic FRONT VIEW of a city gate and very short wall wings. STRICT front elevation, centered and symmetrical or nearly symmetrical, zero isometric perspective, no visible courtyard, no bird's-eye view, no city block, no whole settlement.
Reference image is the ink map: PALETTE and INK MEDIUM only. Preserve its charcoal grey ink, warm ivory and pale ochre, occasional muted sage or celadon. Use a few broad confident hand-painted ink lines and 2-4 flat diluted wash shapes. Painterly edges but very simple masses. Quiet enough to match the map, with stronger silhouette for tiny display. Prefer large readable shapes over detail.
Only 3 to 5 primary silhouette masses, one dark gate opening, no individual roof tiles, bricks, windows, railings, foliage detail or complex architecture. The type must remain readable as a single thumbnail at 32px. Modest Late-Han-inspired roof forms, no exaggerated pagoda curls.
Square transparent canvas; artwork centered, filling about 75% width and 55% height. TRUE alpha background with clear margins; no paper rectangle, ground patch, base disk, UI frame, circle, shield, badge, text, labels, seals or watermark. No people, flags, distant terrain, city name or 3D gloss.
Subject:

entries.label: 帝都
entries.subject: Broad symmetrical imperial gate with a simple double-tier grey roof and two SHORT flanking watchtowers. One large central rectangular dark gate, ivory wall, one tiny muted cinnabar accent. Three roof masses maximum. NO palace behind it.

entries.label: 中原
entries.subject: A simple squat central grey-roof gatehouse and two short straight earthen wall wings. One clear dark rectangular gateway. Symmetrical, balanced, only ONE main roof.

entries.label: 边塞
entries.subject: Two stout SQUARE crenellated earth watchtowers flanking a plain dark central gateway, connected by low battlements. No tiled roof on the towers. Bold military silhouette.

entries.label: 陇右
entries.subject: Low ochre-grey rammed-earth gate with two slightly tapered rounded wall ends and a small simple flat timber cap over the gateway. Modest earthy silhouette, no stone blocks, no houses behind.

entries.label: 巴蜀
entries.subject: One simple gently pitched grey-roof gatehouse, ivory short wall wings, ONE tiny bamboo sprig on a single side. Gate occupies most of silhouette; bamboo only two strokes, not foliage scene.

entries.label: 山城
entries.subject: One compact grey-roof gateway with short terraced wall wings on a VERY LOW uneven stone footing, just two coarse stone shapes. Stepped lower outline conveys hill fort, no mountain behind.

entries.label: 江汉
entries.subject: One plain grey-roof river gate between short ivory walls, a single short horizontal timber quay stroke under one side and TWO pale celadon ripples beneath. NO boat, warehouses or scenery.

entries.label: 江南
entries.subject: One simple elegant grey-roof gate with low short wall wings, a tiny low wooden bridge shape across TWO pale celadon canal strokes at the base. NO extra buildings or willow tree.

scope: Active small frontal campaign-map city icons. Regional variants affect artwork only; detailed regional city illustrations remain preserved for future city interface use.
